question.prompt: Use the quadratic formula to solve \((2x-1)(x+1)=2\). (Separate the two roots with a comma.)

solutions.explanation: Expanding gives \(2x²+x-1=2\), which rearranges to \(2x²+x-3=0\). Then \(b²-4ac=1+24=25\) and \(x=(-1\pm5)/4\), so \(x=1\) or \(x=-3/2\).
solutions.title: Expand and use the quadratic formula
